name: learning-from-experience
title_zh: 任务中途撞见意外就当场记一笔的复盘手账
tagline_zh: 别等收工才回忆。技能失灵、歪打正着、失败后爬起、来源或搭档的批评——只要过程里有料，它当场帮你把这一格钉进经验库。
tagline_en: Don't wait till wrap-up. Skill misfit, a trick that worked, failure-then-recovery, a critique that matters—it.
desc_en: Use mid-task when something procedurally interesting just happened — a skill's procedure didn't fit the situation, a novel approach worked, a failure-then-recovery taught something, a source or your human partner's critique bears on an existing skill, or a procedural surprise resists naming.
why_zh: 它不记流水账，只抓程序性意外：流程没适配、新招奏效、失败后恢复、外部批评。
why_en: It ignores routine and only bites on procedural surprises: mismatched procedures, novel wins, recoveries, external critiques.
limit_zh: 只在任务中途、且确有程序性意外时触发；纯结果复盘、情绪复盘、无新信息的日常重复它不接。产物是经验笔记。
limit_en: Only fires mid-task when a procedural surprise occurs; no pure outcome reviews, emotional debriefs, or routine repeats. Output is an experience.
title_en: Mid-task surprise logger that captures procedural lessons.
